IS 15890 : 2010 : Design, Installation and Testing of Solar Timber Seasoning Kiln - GuidelinesICS 27.160; 79.020CED 9Reaffirmed 20191. ScopeThis standard lays the minimum performance requirements of solar seasoning kiln for seasoning of timber and recommends essential features of equipments, design and installation to attain the desired performance. It applies only to green house type solar kilns with double glazing. Procedure for testing kiln performance has also been outlined.
